preconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c.isdigit() for c in input_string)
preconditions.description: The input string contains only alphabetic characters and digits.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() for c in input_string if c.isdigit())
preconditions.description: Each digit in the input string represents a letter, and the digit is less than or equal to 26.

postconditions.expression: output_string == ''.join(alphabetnums.get(c, c) for c in reversed(input_string) if c.isalpha())
postconditions.description: The output string is the inverse of the input string with respect to alphabetic characters, where each letter is replaced by its corresponding number and vice versa.
